paper.title: Agentic Context Engineering: Evolving Contexts for Self-Improving Language Models
paper.central_claim: ACE将上下文作为细节丰富、持续演化的playbook，通过Generator/Reflector/Curator、局部delta与grow-and-refine克服brevity bias及context collapse，在agents和finance平均提高10.6/8.6个百分点，并降低适应成本，执行反馈下无需真值也能改善。

provenance.notes: 按派发的 sonnet→gpt-6.1-sol；无可绑定的独立运行回执或会话ID，未额外探测。

materials.notes: 3782行固定v3 HTML含附录完整阅读；F中prompts仅图标题，无页图，不虚构图内内容；作者报告缺陷不作材料缺失。

evidence.quote: which are merged deterministically into the existing context by lightweight, non-LLM logic.
evidence.support_explanation: delta局部编辑→确定性合并；非全prompt重写。

evidence.quote: including a unique identifier and counters tracking how often it was marked helpful or harmful
evidence.support_explanation: 条目ID和helpful/harmful元数据供后续归因。

evidence.quote: A de-duplication step then prunes redundancy by comparing bullets via semantic embeddings.
evidence.support_explanation: 有新增/更新/去重/超长修剪，非仅追加。

evidence.quote: for each sample, the model first predicts with the current context, then updates its context based on that sample.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确预测在更新前，在线前题真值不等于同题oracle重试。

evidence.quote: both ACE and other adaptive methods such as Dynamic Cheatsheet may degrade
evidence.support_explanation: 无可靠反馈不能泛化成稳定改善；FiNER在线无GT70.7→67.3。

evidence.quote: For FiNER, Formula and DDXPlus, we follow the original setup and report accuracy, measured as the proportion of predicted answers that exactly match the ground truth.
with and without incremental context updates, and evaluate on the test-normal split with DeepSeek-V3.1.
evidence.support_explanation: delta-off平均56.9 vs full70.3，TGC67.3→76.2、SGC46.4→64.3；内容长度未匹配。

evidence.quote: we run offline adaptation with 1 epoch and 1 reflector refinement round.
evidence.support_explanation: 细粒度成本配置为1/1，不可无条件等同默认最多5/5。
ACE总rollout2075>GEPA1455，同时token下降；与主表rollout下降为不同配置/计数。

evidence.quote: input tokens per query than GEPA due to its richer, more actionable playbook.
evidence.support_explanation: 评估raw input token+117.4%；缓存研究是另模型/账单，不等于原始成本下降。

evidence.quote: except in the extreme case of injecting harmful updates every iteration.
evidence.support_explanation: 持续恶意reflection FiNER66.7<base70.7；有限噪声健壮性。

evidence.quote: The same shuffled test split is used across all methods.
evidence.support_explanation: 同顺序控制；不代表报告跨顺序方差。

evidence.quote: if the Reflector fails to extract meaningful insights from generated traces or outcomes, the constructed context may become noisy or even harmful.
evidence.support_explanation: 保留内容依赖反馈可靠性；无独立逐delta改进验收保证。

signatures.information: Generator轨迹、执行反馈/可选GT、已有bullet ID及helpful/harmful计数
signatures.operation: Generator执行并标注条目→Reflector错误归因/迭代提炼→Curator局部delta→非LLM确定性merge→embedding去重及lazy/proactive修剪
signatures.output: 持续演化的知识/策略/失败bullet集合
signatures.conditions: 后续同域任务可复用；足够可靠的reflector与足够context窗口
signatures.feedback: AppWorld自然执行信号；finance有GT与无GT分别报告
signatures.selection_rule: Curator及helpful/harmful元数据选择编辑，语义去重；未描述独立heldout每edit验收/回退
signatures.selection_data: offline训练轨迹最多5epoch；online先预测后消费该题反馈
signatures.persistence: 带唯一ID的playbook跨任务保留；不训练base权重
signatures.later_use: 下一query的Generator条件化playbook；同任务多轮反思不是唯一留存载体
signatures.claimed_effect: 避免重写丢失细节，提高后续TGC/accuracy，减少构建开销
signatures.failure_boundary: 错误永久化、上下文服务成本增加；可靠反馈缺失或每步恶意反思会退化

gap.author_gap: 提示优化追求简短产生brevity bias；累积经验的全量重写发生context collapse，丢失细粒度领域经验。
gap.checked_gap: 给出一次18,282→122token collapse及性能66.7→57.1个案；delta-off支持维护粒度的实用意义，但非所有memory方法均重写。

claims.text: ACE提高agent与domain性能，并无GT也有效
claims.setting: DeepSeek-V3.1同一模型三角色；AppWorld normal/challenge；FiNER/Formula；A.1其他基座，A.2 DDX/BIRD
claims.selection_vs_test: offline train→test pass@1；online当前题先预测再更新，部分online有offline warmup；GT用于已过题而非未来题
claims.result: AppWorld offline avg42.4→59.4(GT)/57.2(noGT)；online59.5 vs DC51.9；finance offline69.1→81.9(GT)/77.1(noGT)；online FiNER无GT70.7→67.3；delta-off AppWorld normal avg56.9 vs70.3
claims.denominator: 官方split；A.2 ACE各1000训练，GEPA额外500/372验证；A.3 90训练/160评估，非所有主表同配置
counterevidence: AppWorld online normal SGC53.6<DC58.9；无GT不是可靠反馈的替代；BIRD为GPT4o-mini judge而非SQL执行验收；多基座是重新构建不是同一冻结playbook转移
claims.allowed_conclusion: 支持反馈可靠时改进后续任务的留存playbook；不支持普遍正迁移或improver本身持续增强。

claims.setting: 主Table4 AppWorld offline/FiNER online；A.3单epoch单reflection成本分解；另GPT5.1缓存研究
claims.baseline_control: GEPA autoheavy/DC，非同预算精确配对
claims.selection_vs_test: 分别报告构建与部署；更长context不可只算构建
claims.result: 主表offline latency53898→9517s、rollout1434→357；A.3 tokens204.1M→39.3M但rollout1455→2075；服务raw input+117.4%，另缓存91.8%命中
counterevidence: A.3与主表配置/rollout口径不统一；完整默认5/5成本不由1/1外推；缓存账单减少不等于raw资源减少
claims.allowed_conclusion: 具体配置中降低适应token和延迟；不宣称所有阶段/预算都更少rollout或token。

assessment.strongest_supported_claim: offline冻结playbook及online前题反馈的后续消费有官方任务指标和维护粒度消融；反馈质量、服务上下文与预算制约收益。
unresolved: 没有自改进improver算法的留存增强证明；近邻原文、方差、全配置成本与独立逐edit门控尚缺。

E.holdout.reason: offline官方train/test冻结context，online严格先预测后更新；缺近重及类别隔离，GT在线范围明示。
